items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: You take, uh, the majority of them fellas like, uh, Chris Kelly and all those fellas in them days... There used to be a fella by the name of Willie Bontong used to play with Chris Kelly long years ago... That's where Chris Kelly used to play most all the time.

ctx.x: You take, uh, the majority of them fellas like, uh, Chris Kelly and all those fellas in them days, most of them fellas was no kind of a readers.
